summary: Testing complete for GROUPE YAMA+ e-commerce platform update. Tested Admin Featured Products API (PUT /api/admin/products/{id}), PayDunya retry payment and switch-to-COD endpoints, Product variants for smartphones/AC/mattresses, and Order Detail Page payment retry UI. All backend tests pass (17/17). All frontend tests pass (10/10, 1 skipped).

admin_featured_products_api.details: PUT /api/admin/products/{id} correctly updates featured, is_new, featured_order, new_order fields. Auth required. Returns 404 for non-existent products.

paydunya_retry_payment.details: POST /api/payments/paydunya/retry/{order_id} creates new PayDunya checkout for pending/failed orders. Returns checkout_url and token.

paydunya_switch_to_cod.details: POST /api/payments/paydunya/switch-to-cod/{order_id} converts pending payment to Cash on Delivery. Updates payment_status to cod_pending.

product_variants_smartphones.details: Products with category=electronique, subcategory=Smartphones can have variants with capacity (64go-1to) and color options.

product_variants_climatiseur.details: Products with category=electromenager, subcategory=Climatiseur can have variants with puissance CV (1-5 CV).

product_variants_matelas.details: Products with category=decoration, subcategory=Literie & Matelas can have variants with dimensions (90x190 to 200x200).

sur_commande_stock.details: Products with is_on_order=true can be created with stock=0. No stock validation for 'sur commande' products.

order_detail_payment_retry_ui.details: Order detail page shows payment pending alert with 'Réessayer le paiement' and 'Payer à la livraison' buttons for pending/failed orders.

featured_products_query.details: GET /api/products?featured=true returns only featured products. GET /api/products?is_new=true returns only new products.

paydunya_payment_methods.details: GET /api/payments/paydunya/methods returns wave, orange_money, card, free_money, expresso, djamo payment options.

seed_data_creation: Test products created and cleaned up during test runs
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features tested and working. Admin Featured Products API (PUT /api/admin/products/{id}) correctly updates featured/is_new/order fields. PayDunya retry and switch-to-cod endpoints working. Product variants UI shows correctly for Smartphones (capacity/color), Climatiseur (CV), and Matelas (dimensions). Order detail page shows payment retry options for pending orders. Note: Admin page frontend tests require proper auth flow - localStorage token setting doesn't work due to React context initialization timing.
rca_of_issue: No issues found. All features working as expected.
